nodes.label: Cross-Platform Parity
nodes.rationale: macOS, Windows, and Linux are first-class targets; platform-specific detection is hidden behind unified interfaces.

nodes.label: Scheduler Priority Cascade
nodes.rationale: A first-match-wins guard cascade prevents lower-priority timers from advancing while the application is paused, outside active hours, or observing an interruption signal.

nodes.label: Commercially Distributable Sound Bundle
nodes.rationale: Non-commercial tracks were excluded so Entracte remains free to ship under a future business model.

nodes.label: Local-Only Product Scope
nodes.rationale: Cloud sync, telemetry, account systems, and a plugin system are intentionally out of scope.
